summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K disclosing its board's approval to dispose of 1,061 treasury common shares at KRW 99,600 per share (aggregate value KRW 105,675,600) to five independent non-executive directors as bonus compensation under its enterprise-value-linked compensation program. The disposal occurs over-the-counter from August 28 to September 30, 2026, via SK Securities. This is a routine compensation-related share transfer, not a special situation. No change of control, strategic transaction, or capital return event is involved; the filing is a standard administrative disclosure.
